description: Get a single page of a Doc with its content (ClickUp Docs v3). Returns content as markdown by default. Use after `get_doc_page_listing` to read one specific page.

content_format.description: Format to return the content in: 'text/md' (default) or 'text/html'.

doc_id.description: ID of the Doc the page belongs to.

page_id.description: ID of the page to fetch.

team_id.description: Team/Workspace ID. Falls back to CLICKUP_TEAM_ID when omitted.

name: get_doc_page
